taskfile=base/'programs/task-585ba767.py'
code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(out), len(out[0])
    # The three colors along the top form vertical rays; each ray turns
    # horizontally at the row of its matching marker, if one exists.
    top = [(c, out[0][c]) for c in range(w) if out[0][c] != 0]
    for c, color in top:
        markers = [(r, j) for r in range(1, h) for j in range(w) if out[r][j] == color]
        if markers:
            r, j = markers[0]
        else:
            r, j = h - 1, c
        for i in range(min(r, h - 1) + 1):
            out[i][c] = color
        for x in range(min(c, j), max(c, j) + 1):
            out[r][x] = color
    return out
'''
taskfile.write_text(code)
exec(compile(code,str(taskfile),'exec'),globals())

grid[7][0]=4; grid[9][10]=5
ans=transform(grid)

# Validate both demonstrated patterns against their reported outputs.
def mk(n, seeds, markers):
    g=[[0]*n for _ in range(n)]
    for c,v in seeds: g[0][c]=v
    for r,c,v in markers: g[r][c]=v
    return g
